playhorizon.setup: test ! -e ~/.actions-runners/horizon/paused && set -a && . ~/.actions-runners/horizon/.env && set +a && export PATH=$(cat ~/.actions-runners/horizon/.path) && unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY && export DISPLAY=:$(cat ~/.actions-runners/horizon/display)

exclude.mob_ai: the vanilla oracle runs out of its 3 GB heap here (OutOfMemoryError in IO workers; passes on the desktop and the Mac) - 2026-10-26 trial
exclude.lan_integration: two clients rendered on the CPU (lavapipe): different timing subtests fail on each run (elytra, consume-release, barter, critical-hits) - 2026-10-26 trial
exclude.world_reopen: failed twice here (no Save and Quit button after reopening; the minecart-count flake), passes on the desktop - 2026-10-26 trial
exclude.remote_fireball: fails here even alone, at bare main 3b19c386c (2 of 2 runs and the retry), and passes on the Mac mini: the guest's egg is seen in 2 of 6 samples. CPU-starved: the whole horizon-ci slice (runner on 4-7, workers on 0-3) shares a 700% quota and was throttled in 27% of periods, so lavapipe frames and screenshots outlast the projectile's flight - 2026-10-27
exclude.remote_fireworks: fails here even alone, at bare main 3b19c386c (2 of 2 runs and the retry), and passes on the Mac mini: the guest's sparks are gone by its trail screenshot (same CPU starvation as remote_fireball; a private Xvfb on CPUs 0-3 did not help) - 2026-10-27

playhorizon.note: a partner's server (Ubuntu, 8 EPYC threads, 30 GB, Detroit; tailnet only), its CI runner has CPUs 4-7, so workers get 0-3 (as tools/remote.sh runs do) and 3 jobs, in the CI runner's environment, slice and Xvfb screen (tools/ci/linux-runner.sh); the always-on Linux host since the ThinkPad stopped running harnesses (2026-10-26)

hosted.note: Not a worker: the hosted runners without a GPU that .github/workflows/parity-hosted.yml uses. tools/parity_plan.py --hosted leaves these out, and local_only, named_only and (but with --known-failing, as main's full runs) known_failing too, and lists them as not run there.

known_flaky.world_reopen: counted 4 minecarts instead of 3 once on a loaded Mac mini runner, then passed at the same head (10-26)
known_flaky.lunge_motion: a loaded Mac mini runner: the server catches up with two ticks for one of the jump's moves (Alice falls a tick of gravity more, -0.3015 vs -0.2277; the harness now names it), and vanilla's own run once sent an extra motion while sprinting; the same trees pass alone (#5656, 11-01)
known_flaky.server_wool_vibration: real-time dedicated servers: walk-stone missed Horizon's active sensor in 29 of 35 parity-main tries from 11-19 (#18133). Suspected cause: the phase was read 1 to 3 ticks before the sensor's 30 active ticks ended (hosted, 11-20: active 10-39 on vanilla and 12-41 on Horizon, read at 38-39). The hosted reads landed inside both windows, so the failure did not reproduce there. The walks are stepped a tick at a time since, compared tick by tick (the same on both servers); the other cases still run in real time. Off the list once parity-main passes it with no retry
